Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy

 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.34464 Of 2024
Order :

entities.text: Raj General Store vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
(ORAL) This writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of respondent No.6 - the Sub-Inspector of Police, Asifabad Police Station, in interfering with the business activity of the petitioner run under the name and style of 'M/s Raj General Store', No.193, Asifabad main road,
near Apollo Medical, Komuram Bheem Asifabad District, as being illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the products being sold by the petitioner in his shop do not contain tobacco and nicotine and they are not banned products under the provisions of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and rule made there under.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Despite the same, there is interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner.
3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, basing on the written instructions dated 06.12.2024, submitted that respondent No.6 did not visit the shop of the petitioner in the recent past.
Respondent No.6 neither called the petitioner to the Police Station nor harassed him as alleged in the writ affidavit.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader submitted that there is no interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner in any manner.
4. A copy of the written instructions is served on the learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. In view of the categorical statement made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home that there is no interference by respondent No.6 with the business activity of the petitioner,
, the writ petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this writ petition, stand closed.

B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J December 9, 2024 RRK M/S Raj General Store vs State Of Telangana on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128341473/
